'''Danzal Galak Sr.''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who served as a [[Security Guard/Legends|Security Guard]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. He held the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]]<ref name="SWI145" /> during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which took place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character's name was first revealed in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]] department of [[Star Wars Insider 145|''Star Wars Insider'' 145]]. [[Tim Veekhoven]], [[Kevin Beentjes]] and [[Sander de Lange]], who did research for the article, saw him as the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Galak]], a character from the [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game]]''.<ref>{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/creating-naming-the-naboos-finest-rogues-gallery-star-wars-insider-145/630688876981223|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Oct 22, 2013|archivedate=20200412203331}}</ref>
